pages.text: The Aimless Colony is a boss with three phases based on remaining health. Under default settings it has 320 health, six armor and eight attack damage. Its attacks do not damage the chamber.

Leave charge lanes and slam circles. From Division, ring waves leave the center safe; Frenzy adds crossed lanes aimed at a fixed position. Move diagonally out of crossings. Charges can lead to rings and pulls to crossings; each follow-up has its own warning. The last rally warns for 2.5 seconds: stop returning fragments to deny healing.

The body owns 100 cohesion. Each fragment borrows 12; at most six are active. A killed piece never returns its share. Cohesion of 60 or more reduces damage by 10%; at 40 or less the exposed core briefly takes 20% more. The body is always vulnerable.

Stay near the chamber for at least 30 seconds and contribute damage, healing, protection or a real rally. Each slime's owner gets credit. Your first clear here grants one heart and a record; later clears grant two shards. Four shards make another heart.
